calculate_matches: calculate top-k retrieval hits by evaluating if answers exist in retrieved documents using multiprocessing
calculate_matches_from_meta: calculate retrieval hits from document metadata with optional title inclusion and zlib decompression support
calculate_chunked_matches: calculate top-k hits for table chunked documents tracking both chunk and original table level matches
has_answer: check if a document text contains any of the provided answers using string or regex matching
exact_match_score: compute exact match score between a predicted answer and ground truth after normalization
